passages: When the severity of the alleged violation(s) could result in sanctions of suspension or expulsion, or if the facts of the incident are so complex that an administrative hearing is not appropriate, involved students will receive a hearing notice requesting their attendance at a prehearing, which precedes a Board hearing. • Accept responsibility—Students who accept responsibility for all charges proceed to an admitted responsibility meeting, scheduled for a later date. During the admitted responsibility meeting, the Hearing Administrator presents the case to at least two members of the Board who will ask questions to determine the most appropriate sanctions. The student may provide a verbal statement as well as additional written documentation to the Board.
